name: cloud9
description: Cloud9 — chat with your crew of agents and friends, everywhere.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cloud9/shared -w @cloud9/engine -w @cloud9/relay -w @cloud9/desktop && npm run typecheck:app
scripts.pack: npm run build:app && npm run prepack:tools && npm run pack -w @cloud9/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build:app && npm run prepack:tools && npm run dist -w @cloud9/desktop
